selected_script.hook: Tired of dry, rubbery leftovers and messy microwave explosions?

segment_01.voiceover: Tired of dry, rubbery leftovers and microwave explosions? This UFORU cover is a game changer. It stops splatters completely while reheating your food perfectly.
segment_01.action: POV shot showing messy microwave, transitioning to creator holding the UFORU cover. Covering a plate and pouring water into the side reservoir.

segment_02.voiceover: Just add a little water to the side reservoir and adjust the top vent. The steam locks in moisture, so your meals taste freshly cooked every time.
segment_02.action: Hand adjusting top green steam vent, closing microwave door, and showing food heating gently through the clear dome without crazy steam.

segment_03.voiceover: The drainage groove catches extra water, keeping your plate mess-free. Stop eating sad leftovers and upgrade your kitchen routine today.
segment_03.action: Taking plate out, lifting cover via green handle to reveal fresh food. Close-up on bottom green rim catching condensation. Creator takes a bite.

broll_coverage.action: Stable beauty shots of product on counter, hand pouring water into side reservoir and closing green lid, showing fit over a standard bowl.
